title: Geraldine O NDE 338/20531 NDE 20531
content:
338 I fell asleep sitting in my chair at my desk. I awoke later to see my granddaughter there in front of me playing with the cat. That is the last conscious memory that I had until I woke up in ICU. There are other things though that are in my mind. Blackness, soft and not frightening. I knew exactly where I lay on the ground. I could see myself but not with my eyes. It was more like with my mind. I asked a question, 'What happened to me? Did I have a stroke?' That is the last very clear memory that I had of the experience but there was more. I was not alone. All I can remember now is a color against the blackness. Not the type of color one would expect. It was a weathered cream color. Sort of like the color that one would expect the tattered robes of Jesus might be. I can't say that I saw Jesus or any specific individual. I remember a presence and a color and although I am not sure about this there seems to be a vague presence of doors. I remember communication but I don't remember what was said. The only thing that I can remember is a very deep feeling that the number 3 was very important. It was what I was supposed to remember. Always remember the number 3. That is it. I know that I experience communication with someone and I want so much to remember it all but all I come back with is the number three. I have a daughter and two grandchildren that my life revolves around and very possibly the number represents them and how important they are, I just can't remember enough to be sure.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Blackness described as 'soft and not frightening.' Reported seeing herself 'but not with my eyes...with my mind' and knowing where she lay on the ground.

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt 'a presence' but could not identify any specific individual; noted a 'weathered cream color' against blackness, like 'tattered robes of Jesus might be.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Blackness 'soft and not frightening'; 'weathered cream color' against the blackness; vague sense of 'doors.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Felt she was 'supposed to remember' that 'the number 3 was very important' and to 'Always remember the number 3.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Unclear medical event; experiencer wondered, 'Did I have a stroke?' and later awoke in ICU.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Felt a message/importance of 'the number 3'; vague presence of 'doors.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Central remembered element was an instruction/feeling that the number '3' was very important and to 'Always remember the number 3'; also a 'weathered cream color' in the darkness and a vague presence of 'doors.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Blackness, soft and not frightening.” / “I could see myself but not with my eyes. It was more like with my mind.” / “Always remember the number 3.”
